answer_excerpt:
Bottom line: SEC evidence shows no direct transmission channel from an OpenAI bankruptcy to SpaceX operations or balance sheet — both are private with no EDGAR issuer corpus, joint mentions are only parallel pre-IPO fund exposures, agreement/exhibit searches return only fund-level documents, and event feeds show no SpaceX-OpenAI link.

Major direct exposures (SEC-visible): None disclosed. SpaceX has no EDGAR issuer record (4349 third-party mentions only) and OpenAI has no EDGAR issuer record (3622 third-party mentions only), so no 10-K/10-Q/S-1 debt, guarantee or counterparty obligation is observable. Targeted agreement (376 hits) and contract-exhibit (277 hits) searches return only fund administration servicing agreements and ETF Trust exhibits (D)(1)(VII)-(XI), not a bilateral SpaceX-OpenAI operating contract.

Second-order: Co-holding contagion only. Genius 6-K groups SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI as the largest IPO calendar anchored names with exposure via ARK Venture, Destiny Tech100 and Fundrise; Kurv files separate SPAX and OPAI single-stock ETFs as distinct series. An OpenAI failure could therefore hit shared pre-IPO fund NAVs and IPO-window sentiment without impairing SpaceX standalone operations. Tesla filings treat SpaceX as a separate Musk-affiliated entity in proxy context, while Microsoft 8-Ks concentrate OpenAI exposure with no SpaceX link, and MSFT events since 2025 are only earnings/management changes.

Bull: Insulation plus surviving-asset rotation. Separate SPAX/OPAI vehicles and absence of bilateral exhibits support continuity; OpenAI distress could concentrate pre-IPO demand on SpaceX.

Bear: Opacity plus funding-sentiment spill. Private status means SEC cannot exclude undisclosed private contracts; shared fund complex and systemic AI-capex reliance via Microsoft imply funding-tightening risk.

Uncertainties: Whether any non-EDGAR private SpaceX-OpenAI contract, service, or financing exists outside disclosure scope.

SEC-only limitations: This synthesis uses only EDGAR filing text, exhibits and 8-K event feeds; private company operations, launch/Starlink revenues, and non-filed contracts are outside SEC scope by definition.

Filing refs: Genius 6-K 0001493152-26-027417 (2026-06-05 Ex99.2); Kurv N-1A 0001999371-26-003965 (2026-02-23 SPAX/OPAI); Tesla 8-K 0001628280-26-049213 (2026-07-22); Microsoft 8-Ks 0001193125-25-256310, 0001193125-26-027198, 0001193125-26-323632.
